name: trackiq-amazon-share-of-shelf
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Share of Shelf
summary: Measures how much of Amazon page one a brand owns for the keywords that carry its revenue — organic slots, sponsored slots and Amazon's Choice badges per keyword, rolled up by category, against the competitor brands holding the rest, with week-over-week movement and the revenue behind every keyword the brand is absent from.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection for live Amazon search results: 1 credit per keyword per run, plus a one-off 1 credit per ASIN for brand resolution. There is no first-party substitute — without it the report cannot be produced.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

fallback: None for the shelf itself. Live search results cannot be substituted from first-party data, and the skill says so rather than approximating page one from rank tracking.
